Mauritius-Africa Scholarship Scheme 2027 (MPhil and PhD in Mauritius)
entries.old: Two stages (guidelines, section 9.3): '1. Apply for a seat in a public HEI by end of January 2027. The HEI will provide the applicant a receipt of having applied for a seat.' 2. Submit the 2027 application form through the nominating agency of your country, by a deadline that agency communicates. The agency endorses at most 15 candidates and sends the files to the Ministry: 'Soft copies of all documents 17 March 2027; Hard copies of all documents 31 March 2027.' The call is dated October 2026.
entries.new: Two stages (guidelines, section 9.3): '1. Apply for a seat in a public HEI by end of January 2027. The HEI will provide the applicant a receipt of having applied for a seat.'
